raw:
@s1 stated
  relation "receive notification"
  role subject "a few patients on the user's family medicine list"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s2 stated
  relation "be listed as uninsured in SIUI"
  role subject "a few patients on the user's family medicine list"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s3 stated
  relation "have an employment contract"
  role subject "a few patients on the user's family medicine list"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@q query
  select ?p
  where all
    match
      relation "be listed as uninsured in SIUI"
      role subject ?p
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "be in"
      role subject ?p
      role location "Mureș county"
      polarity affirmed
    end
  end
